post.summary: Open a USDC payment for a lease
post.description: Accepts a tenant-session JWT (human after switch-tenant) or a gateway exchange JWT from a purpose=service key or a renter key minted via the org-admin API. Not a portal paste. Not a KV-stashed portal JWT. Raw Keycloak without tenant_id is 403. No card is charged. The renter pays the amount in USDC on Base.

post.summary: Settle a lease payment from the test-network credit
post.description: Available only where PAYMENTS_USDC_TEST_CREDIT_ENABLED is true and the deployment is Base Sepolia with Stripe in test mode. Marks the pending USDC payment succeeded and publishes payment.succeeded.v1, the same event a confirmed chain transfer publishes. Not available on Base mainnet.

AuthenticatorTransport.title: AuthenticatorTransport
AuthenticatorTransport.description:
How an authenticator communicates to the client/browser.

Members:
    `USB`: USB wired connection
    `NFC`: Near Field Communication
    `BLE`: Bluetooth Low Energy
    `INTERNAL`: Direct connection (read: a platform authenticator)
    `CABLE`: Cloud Assisted Bluetooth Low Energy
    `HYBRID`: A combination of (often separate) data-transport and proximity mechanisms

https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-2/#enum-transport

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Must be a supported currency: https://docs.stripe.com/currencies

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: The product whose pricing the created plan will represent. This must be the ID of an existing product.

unit_amount.title: Unit Amount
unit_amount.description: A positive integer in cents (or 0 for a free price) representing how much to charge. One of unit_amount, unit_amount_decimal, or custom_unit_amount is required, unless billing_scheme=tiered.

product.title: Product
product.description: The ID of the product this price is associated with

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the price is active or not

interval_count.title: Interval Count
interval_count.description: Number of intervals between each billing cycle

usage_type.title: Usage Type
usage_type.description: Configures how the quantity per period should be determined. Can be either metered or licensed. licensed automatically bills the quantity set when adding it to a subscription. metered aggregates the total usage based on usage records. Defaults to licensed.

is_trial.title: Is Trial
is_trial.description: Indicates if the subscription is a trial

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: The tenant who owns the subscription

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: who it is applied to, If end_user, then user_id must be set

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: The end user who has this subscription, if applicable

identity_provider_hint.title: Identity Provider Hint
identity_provider_hint.description: Keycloak broker alias (e.g. google, github, microsoft) passed as kc_idp_hint.

PoliticalViewCategory.title: PoliticalViewCategory
PoliticalViewCategory.description: Coarse, opt-in self-description for policy context (handle as sensitive data).

SexualOrientationCategory.title: SexualOrientationCategory
SexualOrientationCategory.description: Opt-in category; treat as special-category personal data under GDPR.

SociACLAttributes.title: SociACLAttributes
SociACLAttributes.description: Optional SociACL dimensions attached to a policy. Highly sensitive — minimize collection.

CryptoBudgetCreateRequest.title: CryptoBudgetCreateRequest
CryptoBudgetCreateRequest.description: Create an in-app Solana-style budget envelope (pubkeys only; no private keys stored).

extra.title: Extra
extra.description: 4th request field for ABAC model (e.g. political_view category)

PolicyRuleCreate.title: PolicyRuleCreate
PolicyRuleCreate.description: One Casbin policy row: ptype + values mapped to v0..v5.

owner_attributes.description: MVP/tests: owner SociACL dimensions; production should load from user-service.

cross_network_handle_allowlist.title: Cross Network Handle Allowlist
cross_network_handle_allowlist.description: If set, requester handle must match one entry (exact).

SociACLPredicate.title: SociACLPredicate
SociACLPredicate.description: JSON-serializable rules stored on share links; evaluated server-side.

SociACLRequestContext.title: SociACLRequestContext
SociACLRequestContext.description: Requester-supplied context for evaluation (trust labels are advisory).

SociACLShareLinkPublic.title: SociACLShareLinkPublic
SociACLShareLinkPublic.description: Non-sensitive resolve payload for anonymous callers.

SociaclShareCreatedResponse.title: SociaclShareCreatedResponse
SociaclShareCreatedResponse.description: Returned once from POST /acl/sociacl/shares; includes raw token.

budget_id.title: Budget Id
budget_id.description: Crypto agent budget (payment-service); required when billing_mode is crypto.

stripe_customer_id.title: Stripe Customer Id
stripe_customer_id.description: Optional Stripe customer id for metered usage events.

secret_plaintext.title: Secret Plaintext
secret_plaintext.description: Full key prefix.secret — store securely; never shown again.

listing_id.title: Listing Id
listing_id.description: Marketplace listing this payment buys. The server writes it to billing extra_metadata.listing_id, which marketplace purchase checks. A listing_id key in metadata is ignored.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Optional string map copied onto billing extra_metadata. Platform keys tenant_id and payment_rail win. lease_id and listing_id from a browser client are ignored. Do not send secrets.

UsdcLeasePaymentCreate.title: UsdcLeasePaymentCreate
UsdcLeasePaymentCreate.description:
POST /payments/usdc/lease-payments

Opens a pending USDC payment for one lease. The price clears 1:1 from
USD cents into USDC atoms. No card is involved.

amount_atoms.title: Amount Atoms
amount_atoms.description: USDC atoms (6 decimals). 64-bit: large payments exceed 32 bits.

chain_id.title: Chain Id
chain_id.description: Base chain id from deployment config, when set.

test_credit_available.title: Test Credit Available
test_credit_available.description: True only where PAYMENTS_USDC_TEST_CREDIT_ENABLED is set and the deployment is Base Sepolia with Stripe in test mode. The renter may then settle this payment from a test-network credit.

UsdcLeasePaymentResponse.title: UsdcLeasePaymentResponse
UsdcLeasePaymentResponse.description: A USDC lease payment. ``amount_atoms`` has 6 decimals.
